correctness.rationale: For ternary words the gap G(w) is minimum over every i<j<k of (k-i-2LCS(w[i:j],w[j:k]))/(k-i); strict G>1/8 is equivalent to 16LCS<7(k-i), including unequal adjacent block lengths. Relabel symbols in order of first appearance to a unique restricted-growth word. Prefix inheritance means the exhaustive recursion need test only interval triples with new right endpoint; the exact one-row LCS DP computes all such values without heuristics. Independently rebuilt this enumeration and reproduced the entire 28-entry level-count vector (1,1,2,3,5,7,10,13,14,18,17,17,16,15,12,11,10,9,9,10,11,10,9,9,10,11,1,0). Its sole canonical n=27 survivor is 012010212021012102010212012, hence six alphabet permutations, and no n=28 survivor. Independently exhaustively computed all 3276 triples for the witness with exact fractions; minimum 3/23 only at (0,12,23) and (4,15,27); no other length27 word can improve since it has G<=1/8. Prefix obstruction excludes every n>28. Inspected the second separately encoded squarefree candidate census over 5162 length27 and 6740 length28 words beginning 0; it provides additional independent exhaustive confirmation, not a bound on all untested infinite lengths.
residual_risks: Finite calculations support the structural proof; they are not a proof by sampling.
